evidence_slice: Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea adopted its Local Plan 2024 on 24 July 2024. Policy SA1 identifies the Kensal Canalside Opportunity Area as an area for growth. The adopted Local Plan describes the site as approximately 15.4 hectares and Policy SA1 provides for around 3,500 or more new homes and around 12,000 square metres or more of non-residential floorspace. The Council's current Kensal Canalside major-development page confirms that KCOA remains an allocated site under Local Plan 2024 and records planning application PP/23/06575 for Sainsbury's and surrounding former utilities land, Canal Way.
